features.title: Heading enforcement, post-generation correction pass, ora spinner
features.user_visible_behavior: Generated harness artifacts keep exact template headings (e.g. '## Current State' not '## Current Build Status'). After each LLM write, a deterministic heading corrector runs: drifted headings are replaced via Dice bigram similarity (threshold 0.6), genuinely missing sections are added via a focused LLM call. A spinner shows 'Generating...' / 'Correcting headings...' during each artifact's LLM call, then stops cleanly. generateOnly artifacts (template copies) skip both the spinner and the corrector.
evidence: npm run build: dist/cli.js 109.54 KB, zero errors
features.agent_notes: Module 1: generator.ts SYSTEM_PROMPT replaced with strict heading rules (exact character-for-character, lists '## Current State', '## Stack', '## What this is' as examples). Module 2: new src/init/corrector.ts with findDriftedHeadings() (Dice bigram similarity), replaceHeadings() (regex replace), correctHeadings() (deterministic + optional LLM for missing sections); wired into both executeGenerate and executeImprove before write; cleanLLMOutput applied to corrected output. Module 3: ora@5 spinner in executor.ts (not ora@8 — ESM-only breaks CJS bundle); spinner skipped for generateOnly artifacts; 7 spinner tests with vi.mock('ora'). DECISIONS.md updated with ora@5 rationale.
